meanings.en: bad-tempered and easily annoyed
meanings.exampleEn: The baby gets cranky when she misses her nap.
meanings.exampleTr: Bebek uykusunu kaçırınca huysuzlaşıyor.

meanings.tr: kravat, boyun atkısı (eski tip fular kravat)
meanings.en: a wide band of fabric worn by men around the neck and tucked inside a shirt
meanings.exampleEn: He wore a silk cravat instead of a tie.
meanings.exampleTr: Kravat yerine ipek bir fular takmıştı.

meanings.en: a place where babies and young children are cared for while their parents work
meanings.exampleEn: They left their daughter at the crèche before going to the office.
meanings.exampleTr: Ofise gitmeden önce kızlarını kreşe bıraktılar.

meanings.en: too willing to believe that something is real or true
meanings.exampleEn: Credulous investors were easily fooled by the scheme.
meanings.exampleTr: Saf yatırımcılar bu düzenle kolayca kandırıldı.

meanings.en: the quality of being firm, fresh and crunchy, or clear and sharp
meanings.exampleEn: I love the crispness of a fresh apple.
meanings.exampleTr: Taze bir elmanın çıtırlığına bayılıyorum.

meanings.tr: mırıldanarak yumuşak söylemek, alçak sesle şarkı söylemek
meanings.en: to sing or speak in a soft, low, gentle voice
meanings.exampleEn: He would croon lullabies to his baby every night.
meanings.exampleTr: Her gece bebeğine ninniler mırıldanırdı.

meanings.en: oil in its natural state before it has been refined
meanings.exampleEn: The price of crude oil rose sharply last week.
meanings.exampleTr: Ham petrol fiyatı geçen hafta keskin bir şekilde yükseldi.

meanings.en: the quality of being rude, unrefined, or roughly made
meanings.exampleEn: The crudeness of his jokes offended some guests.
meanings.exampleTr: Şakalarının kabalığı bazı misafirleri rahatsız etti.

meanings.en: easily broken into small pieces
meanings.exampleEn: This cheese is dry and crumbly.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu peynir kuru ve ufalanıyor.

meanings.en: a loud sound made when something hard is crushed or bitten
meanings.exampleEn: I heard the crunch of gravel under the tires.
meanings.exampleTr: Lastiklerin altındaki çakılın çatırtısını duydum.

meanings.en: a critical situation caused by a shortage, especially of money
meanings.exampleEn: Many families felt the financial crunch during the recession.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok aile durgunluk sırasında mali darboğazı hissetti.

meanings.en: a machine used for crushing something, such as rocks or ice
meanings.exampleEn: The factory uses a stone crusher to break up the rocks.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrika kayaları parçalamak için bir taş kırıcı kullanıyor.

meanings.en: a sea creature with a hard shell and several pairs of legs, such as a crab or lobster
meanings.exampleEn: Crabs and shrimp are types of crustacean.
meanings.exampleTr: Yengeç ve karides birer kabuklu deniz hayvanıdır.

meanings.tr: can alıcı nokta, esas mesele, özü
meanings.en: the most important or central point of a problem or issue
meanings.exampleEn: The crux of the matter is whether we can afford it.
meanings.exampleTr: Meselenin özü, buna gücümüzün yetip yetmediğidir.

meanings.en: having a hidden meaning that is difficult to understand
meanings.exampleEn: She left a cryptic note that no one could decode.
meanings.exampleTr: Kimsenin çözemediği muğlak bir not bıraktı.

meanings.en: a message or text written in code or cipher
meanings.exampleEn: The spy sent a cryptogram that took hours to decode.
meanings.exampleTr: Casus, çözülmesi saatler süren şifreli bir mesaj gönderdi.

meanings.en: used to measure volume; shaped like a cube
meanings.exampleEn: The tank holds ten cubic metres of water.
meanings.exampleTr: Tank on metreküp su alıyor.

meanings.en: large, heavy, and difficult to carry or use; slow and inefficient
meanings.exampleEn: The old machine was cumbersome and hard to move.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski makine hantaldı ve taşınması zordu.

meanings.en: clever at deceiving people to get what you want
meanings.exampleEn: The fox is often described as a cunning animal.
meanings.exampleTr: Tilki çoğu zaman kurnaz bir hayvan olarak tanımlanır.

meanings.en: to control or limit something in order to stop it increasing
meanings.exampleEn: The government introduced measures to curb inflation.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümet enflasyonu dizginlemek için önlemler aldı.

meanings.en: quick and not thorough; done without attention to detail
meanings.exampleEn: He gave the report only a cursory glance.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapora sadece üstünkörü bir göz attı.

meanings.en: to reduce or limit something, especially by cutting it short
meanings.exampleEn: The company had to curtail spending during the crisis.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket kriz sırasında harcamaları kısmak zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: the act of reducing or limiting something
meanings.exampleEn: The curtailment of public services angered many citizens.
meanings.exampleTr: Kamu hizmetlerinin kısıtlanması birçok vatandaşı öfkelendirdi.

meanings.en: a person who is responsible for taking care of something, such as a building or valuable items
meanings.exampleEn: The museum's custodian keeps the collection safe.
meanings.exampleTr: Müzenin sorumlusu koleksiyonu güvende tutar.

meanings.en: the legal right to take care of a child, especially after divorce
meanings.exampleEn: The mother was granted custody of the children.
meanings.exampleTr: Anneye çocukların velayeti verildi.

meanings.en: the state of being kept in prison, especially while waiting for trial
meanings.exampleEn: The suspect was taken into police custody.
meanings.exampleTr: Şüpheli polis gözaltına alındı.

meanings.en: to change something to make it suitable for a particular person or purpose
meanings.exampleEn: You can customize the software to fit your needs.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazılımı ihtiyaçlarınıza göre özelleştirebilirsiniz.

meanings.en: sold at a price that is lower than usual
meanings.exampleEn: They bought cut-price tickets for the early flight.
meanings.exampleTr: Erken uçuş için indirimli biletler aldılar.

meanings.tr: tırnak eti, tırnak diplerindeki deri; dış zar
meanings.en: the hard skin at the base of a fingernail or toenail
meanings.exampleEn: She pushed back her cuticles before applying nail polish.
meanings.exampleTr: Oje sürmeden önce tırnak etlerini geri itti.

meanings.en: (of remarks) unkind and intended to hurt someone's feelings
meanings.exampleEn: She made a cutting remark about his appearance.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun görünüşü hakkında iğneleyici bir yorum yaptı.

meanings.tr: karamsar, güvensiz, insanların iyi niyetine inanmayan
meanings.en: believing that people are only interested in themselves and not sincere
meanings.exampleEn: He has a cynical attitude towards politicians.
meanings.exampleTr: Politikacılara karşı güvensiz bir tutumu var.

meanings.en: in a way that shows you believe people act only out of self-interest
meanings.exampleEn: He cynically dismissed the charity as a publicity stunt.
meanings.exampleTr: Hayır işini alaycı bir şekilde reklam amaçlı bir gösteri olarak nitelendirdi.

meanings.en: the belief that people are motivated only by self-interest, and a distrust of others
meanings.exampleEn: Years of broken promises had bred deep cynicism among voters.
meanings.exampleTr: Yıllarca tutulmayan sözler seçmenlerde derin bir güvensizlik yaratmıştı.

meanings.tr: azalttı, söndürdü, hevesini kırdı (dampen'in geçmiş hali)
meanings.en: made a feeling or activity less strong; made something slightly wet
meanings.exampleEn: The bad weather dampened our enthusiasm for the trip.
meanings.exampleTr: Kötü hava, geziye olan hevesimizi kırdı.

meanings.tr: gözü pek kimse, cesur ve tehlikeli işler yapan
meanings.en: a person who enjoys doing dangerous things and takes risks
meanings.exampleEn: The daredevil jumped off the cliff with a parachute.
meanings.exampleTr: Gözü pek adam paraşütle uçurumdan atladı.

meanings.en: a woman who has dark-coloured hair
meanings.exampleEn: A dark-haired woman was waiting at the entrance.
meanings.exampleTr: Girişte koyu saçlı bir kadın bekliyordu.

meanings.en: to spread a substance such as paint or mud on a surface carelessly
meanings.exampleEn: Someone had daubed graffiti all over the wall.
meanings.exampleTr: Biri duvarın her yerine grafiti bulaştırmıştı.

meanings.en: to move or do something very slowly, wasting time
meanings.exampleEn: Stop dawdling or we'll miss the bus.
meanings.exampleTr: Oyalanmayı bırak yoksa otobüsü kaçıracağız.

meanings.tr: cansızlık, hissizlik, ölü gibi olma hali
meanings.en: the quality of lacking life, feeling, or activity
meanings.exampleEn: There was a strange deadness in his eyes.
meanings.exampleTr: Gözlerinde tuhaf bir cansızlık vardı.

meanings.tr: ifadesiz, ciddi bir yüzle (özellikle şaka yaparken)
meanings.en: showing no emotion or expression, especially when saying something funny
meanings.exampleEn: He delivered the joke in a deadpan voice.
meanings.exampleTr: Şakayı ifadesiz bir sesle söyledi.

meanings.en: a lack or scarcity of something
meanings.exampleEn: There is a dearth of affordable housing in the city.
meanings.exampleTr: Şehirde uygun fiyatlı konut kıtlığı var.

meanings.en: the number of deaths in a particular area or period, usually per 1,000 people
meanings.exampleEn: The country's death rate has fallen over the past decade.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülkenin ölüm oranı son on yılda düştü.

meanings.en: to reduce the quality, value, or dignity of something
meanings.exampleEn: Printing too much money can debase the currency.
meanings.exampleTr: Çok fazla para basmak, paranın değerini düşürebilir.

meanings.en: in a way that is open to question or dispute
meanings.exampleEn: Debatably, this is his best film to date.
meanings.exampleTr: Tartışmalı da olsa, bu onun bugüne kadarki en iyi filmi.

meanings.en: to reduce speed; to slow down
meanings.exampleEn: The train began to decelerate as it approached the station.
meanings.exampleTr: Tren istasyona yaklaşırken yavaşlamaya başladı.

meanings.en: behaviour that is honest, respectable, and morally correct
meanings.exampleEn: He didn't even have the decency to apologize.
meanings.exampleTr: Özür dileyecek nezaketi bile göstermedi.

meanings.en: to move power or control from a central authority to several smaller local ones
meanings.exampleEn: The government plans to decentralize decision-making to local councils.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümet karar alma sürecini yerel meclislere devretmeyi planlıyor.
